info.description:
API for retrieving connected client businesses associated with a Meta application.


This endpoint allows applications to retrieve information about businesses that have
established client connections through the application. This is essential for managing
business relationships and understanding client business configurations.

interactive.description: An object containing the content for an interactive message.

type.description: The type of interactive message to send.

header.description: Header content displayed on top of a message. Required for 'product_list' type. Cannot be set for 'product' type.

text.description: Text for the header. Required if 'type' is 'text'. Emojis supported, no markdown.

sub_text.description: Optional sub-text for the header. Emojis supported, no markdown.

document.description: Contains the media object for this document. Required if 'type' is 'document'.

id.description: The media object ID. **Required when `link` is not used.**

link.description: The protocol and URL of the media to be sent (HTTP/HTTPS only).

image.description: Contains the media object for this image. Required if 'type' is 'image'.

id.description: The media object ID. **Required when `link` is not used.**

link.description: The protocol and URL of the media to be sent (HTTP/HTTPS only).

video.description: Contains the media object for this video. Required if 'type' is 'video'.

id.description: The media object ID. **Required when `link` is not used.**

link.description: The protocol and URL of the media to be sent (HTTP/HTTPS only).

body.description: An object with the body of the message. Optional for 'product' type, required for other interactive message types.

text.description: The content of the message body. Emojis and markdown are supported.

footer.description: An object with the footer of the message. Optional.

text.description: The footer content. Emojis, markdown, and links are supported.

action.description: Action you want the user to perform after reading the message. Its structure varies by interactive message type.

button.description: Button content for List Messages. Cannot be empty, must be unique. Emojis supported, no markdown.

items.description: A section object, used in List Messages and Multi-Product Messages.

title.description: Title of the section. Required if the message has more than one section. Max 24 characters.

product_retailer_id.description: Unique identifier of the product in a catalog.

type.description: Only supported type is "reply" for Reply Button.

id.description: Unique identifier for your button. No leading/trailing spaces.

title.description: Button title. Cannot be empty, must be unique. Emojis supported, no markdown.

catalog_id.description: Unique identifier of the Facebook catalog linked to your WhatsApp Business Account.

product_retailer_id.description: Unique identifier of the product in a catalog. Required for Single Product Messages.

items.description: A section object, used in List Messages and Multi-Product Messages.

title.description: Title of the section. Required if the message has more than one section. Max 24 characters.

product_retailer_id.description: Unique identifier of the product in a catalog.

thumbnail_product_retailer_id.description: Product retailer ID for the thumbnail.

flow_id.description: Unique identifier of the Flow provided by WhatsApp. Required unless flow_name is set. Cannot be used with flow_name.

flow_name.description: The name of the Flow that you created. Required unless flow_id is set. Cannot be used with flow_id.

flow_cta.description: Text on the CTA button (e.g., "Signup"). Advised 30 characters or less, no emoji.

mode.description: The current mode of the Flow, either "draft" or "published".

flow_token.description: A token generated by the business to serve as an identifier. Defaults to "unused".

flow_action.description: Either "navigate" to predefine the first screen, or "data_exchange" for advanced use cases.

screen.description: The 'id' of the first screen of the Flow.

data.description: The input data for the first screen of the Flow. Must be a non-empty object.

message_status.description:
The status of a WhatsApp message:
- `accepted`: The message has been accepted by WhatsApp and is being processed
- `held_for_quality_assessment`: The message is being held for quality assessment before delivery
- `paused`: The message delivery has been paused
